tha-ap121:1.1: Paccupaṭṭhānasaññaka.] Atthadassimhi sugate nibbute samanantarā / yakkhayoniṃ upapajjiṃ yasapatto c' ahaṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap121:2.1: Dulladdhaṃ vata me āsi, duppabhātaṃ duruṭṭhitaṃ / yaṃ me bhoge vijjamāne parinibbāyi cakkhumā. // //
tha-ap121:3.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya Sāgaro nāma sāvako / mamuddharitukāmo so āgañchi mama santike. // // ‘Kin
tha-ap121:4.1: nu socasi mā bhāyi varadhammasumedhasa / anuppadinnā Buddhena sabbesaṃ bījasampadā. // //
tha-ap121:5.1: Yo ca pūjeyya sambuddhaṃ Siddhatthaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / dhātuṃ sāsapamattam hi nibbutassāpi pūjaye. // //
tha-ap121:6.1: Same cittappasādamhi samaṃ puññaṃ mahaggataṃ / tasmā thūpaṃ karitvāna pūjesi jinadhātuyo.' // //
tha-ap121:7.1: Sāgarassa vaco sutvā Buddhathūpaṃ akās' ahaṃ / pañcavasse paricariṃ munino thūpam uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap121:8.1: Tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha / sampattiṃ anubhotvāna arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap121:9.1: Bhūripaññā ca cattāro sattakappasate ito / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap121:10.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap121:11.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Paccupaṭṭhānasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
